'''2011 Belgium Regionals Jerome Nitschke LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jerome Nitschke]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jérôme Nitschke
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
